documents.title: AFM nanotribology of [BMIM][BF4] on mica
documents.notes: Single-condition AFM fixture covering base fields plus potential, velocity, roughness, probe, and concentration.
documents.text:
[PAGE 1]
AFM nanotribology of [BMIM][BF4] on mica
The ionic liquid [BMIM] [BF4] was studied between a silicon nitride AFM tip and freshly cleaved mica. Measurements were made at 25 C under a normal load of 5 nN. The applied potential was +0.5 V and the lateral velocity was 2 um/s. The mica roughness was 1 nm. The coefficient of friction was 0.12 for neat [BMIM][BF4].

documents.title: Potential-controlled friction of [EMIM][TFSI] on HOPG
documents.notes: Single-condition electroresponsive AFM fixture on graphite/HOPG.
documents.text:
[PAGE 1]
Potential-controlled friction of [EMIM][TFSI] on HOPG
[EMIM] [TFSI] was confined between a silica colloid probe and HOPG at 298 K. The experiment used a 10 nN load and 4 um/s sliding velocity. At -0.2 V the coefficient of friction was 0.08. The water content was below 100 ppm.

documents.title: Boundary-layer friction of [PYR14][FAP] on Au(111)
documents.notes: Fixture covering film-layer extraction and additives.
documents.text:
[PAGE 1]
Boundary-layer friction of [PYR14][FAP] on Au(111)
A [PYR14] [FAP] ionic liquid film was measured on Au(111) with a diamond AFM probe. The test temperature was 293 K, the normal force was 2 nN, and the sliding speed was 6 um/s. Force-distance curves showed 3 layers in the boundary film. The coefficient of friction was 0.04 with 1 wt% water additive.
